title: ARC-AGI-3 causal reasoning trace
entry_trigger: User requested a new target that would be externally impressive to trace after pinning GEMS.
goal: Solve ARC-AGI-3 on first contact with total discovery+execution environment actions near or better than human first-run baselines. Banked-path efficiency is supporting evidence, not the acceptance condition.
definition_of_solved_for_first_trace: Every admitted rule is tied to an observable state transition or replay witness.
Failed hypotheses remain preserved rather than silently rewritten.
The inferred goal is distinguished from the mechanics used to reach it.
A compact world model predicts at least one later state transition before it is observed.
The final trace explains a successful or meaningfully advancing action sequence without relying on hidden instructions.
The output can be presented unchanged as input to the same trace contract on another public environment.

swallowed_evidence.correction: Public-demo tracing/world-model/falsification approaches already have strong prior art. A single public-game trace is not sufficient for an impressive external claim.
differentiating_boundary: cross-environment transfer without game-specific contract changes

forward_match.exact_boundary: Experiment #2 established recursive implementation of relation admission under a supplied correspondence condition; it did not justify that correspondence principle as general A/B.
forward_match.intended_gain: replace repeated live probing with internally generated falsifiable predictions, then spend actions on high-discrimination witnesses
forward_match.correction: Prefer same-environment repeated/symmetric contexts first. Across environments, carry the contract/representation, not raw action semantics.

experiments.correction: Official ARC docs supply ACTION1-4 direction semantics; game-specific transition consequences still require local evidence.

selector.validation: FM-005 reproduces the LS20 discriminating ACTION2 choice using only pre-witness predictions.

direct_solve.acceptance: Measure the untouched first-contact run including discovery actions; never replace it with a later banked/minimized replay score.
direct_solve.public_goal: 25/25 public games under one generic solver with discovery-inclusive first-contact efficiency at/above human baseline.
direct_solve.private_claim_boundary: Only official hidden evaluation can establish competition 100%.
direct_solve.first_run_rule: The first public evaluation must preserve the exact agent hash and count discovery + execution actions; later banked/minimized replay paths cannot replace this witness.

operator.role: ChatGPT-directed live action loop with append-only transcript once a computer is connected.

public_prior_art.public_completion: OpenWorld Fable archive reports 25/25 games and 183/183 levels source-free.
public_prior_art.rhae_scope: Reported RHAE 100 scores banked replay paths; E149 explicitly says discovery exploration/model-building/search cost is omitted.
public_prior_art.consequence: Do not spend effort proving public completion is possible. Target first-contact discovery economy.

official_action_priors.boundary: Direction semantics are supplied for ACTION1-4; affected object, movement scale, collision/side effects, goals, and game-specific interactions still require current-game evidence.
